svg.title: Kenzo O'Bryan, fullstack developer
svg.text: Fullstack developer. In the evenings I build tools for LLM apps,
mostly the code that runs when the model or the API fails.
a circuit breaker for LLM API calls
evals that catch my RAG agent making things up
an MCP server for GitHub issues, read-only by default
TypeScript · Node.js · Python · Flutter · C · FastAPI · React · Docker
